final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions AS oe JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(o.recordvault AS TEXT) = CAST(oe.ordersmark AS TEXT) GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_of_avg_fill FROM step1 GROUP BY timespan), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordersmark, s1.timespan, s1.avg_fill, s1.avg_fill - s2.avg_of_avg_fill AS difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON CAST(s1.timespan AS TEXT) = CAST(s2.timespan AS TEXT) WHERE s1.avg_fill > s2.avg_of_avg_fill), step4 AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, difference, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC) AS rank_within_timespan FROM step3) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, difference, rank_within_timespan FROM step4 WHERE rank_within_timespan <= 3
